jobs.title: Early-Career Environmental Scientist - Contaminated Land
jobs.description:
* Great opportunity to join our long-established Contaminated Land consulting group in Perth
* Enjoy mentoring and access to our senior specialists
* Diverse projects and learning opportunities across multiple sectors and clients

Tetra Tech Coffey provides high-end environmental, geotechnical, digital, and engineering design consulting services in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea. Every day, our people come together to solve complex challenges for our clients.  
  
With over 30,000 Tetra Tech colleagues across 550 offices globally, we deliver projects that improve lives through science, technology, and innovation.

**About the role**

As an early-career professional, you’ll work alongside our team of experienced environmental professionals who are dedicated to helping you grow and succeed. You'll gain hands-on experience in assessing and remediating contaminated land, and developing essential skills in client engagement, proposal development, and project management.

You’ll work on a diverse range of exciting and challenging contaminated land projects across multiple industries including Defence, Mining, Oil & Gas and Government.

This is a great opportunity to grow a rewarding career in a global consultancy that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence in environmental solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

* Conduct fieldwork for a variety of contaminated site investigation and remediation projects, including soil, groundwater, surface water, and ground gas sampling.
* Observe, guide, and document site remediation activities to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
* Manage, interpret, and ensure the quality of data through rigorous quality assurance and quality control processes.
* Assist in writing proposals, project correspondence, and technical reports to communicate findings and recommendations effectively.

**About you**

To thrive in the role, you should ideally demonstrate the following:

* A degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or Geosciences.
* A minimum of 12 months gained in contaminated land fieldwork.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling you to convey complex information clearly and effectively.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a collaborative team-oriented mindset.
* Genuine enthusiasm for producing high-quality work that delivers practical solutions for our clients.
* A commitment to maintaining high health and safety standards for yourself, your team, and any contractors involved.
* Willingness to undertake remote fieldwork across Australia.
* Permanent residency in Australia.
* An unrestricted Australian driver’s license.

If you’re keen to build your specialist consulting career and contribute to meaningful environmental projects, we’d love you to apply!  
  
**You’ll enjoy these benefits:**

* **Work-Life balance:** We help you create space for other important aspects of your life with study breaks and leave purchase plans allowing you to enjoy up to 8 weeks of annual leave per year!
* **Diverse project opportunities:** Work on a wide range of projects across various clients and sectors, keeping your experience fresh and engaging.
* **Professional growth:** Access ongoing development opportunities, including coaching from our approachable technical experts and support for professional memberships.
* **Employee ownership:** Participate in our employee stock purchase plan and share in the company’s success.
* **Paid parental leave:** Enjoy paid parental leave for both primary and secondary caregivers.
* **Wellbeing support:** Access our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), available to all staff and their immediate families.

  

**About us**

Tetra Tech Coffey provides high-end environmental, geotechnical, digital, and engineering design consulting services in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea. Every day, our people come together to solve complex challenges for our clients.

With over 30,000 Tetra Tech colleagues across 550 offices globally, we deliver projects that improve lives through science, technology, and innovation.

Our commitment to creating lasting, measurable value is reflected in our global 1 Billion People Challenge, which tracks how our 100,000+ annual projects benefit people and communities around the world.

Additional Information

* Organization: 754 COF

jobs.title: Environmental Data Validation Chemist
jobs.description:
**Environmental Data Validation Chemist (Part-Time, Remote)**

**Location:** Remote (U.S.-based). Not open to residents of California, Colorado, Illinois, North Dakota, Ohio, Washington, or Wyoming.

**Schedule:** Part-time, approximately 20–29 hours per week, W-2 hourly

**Experience:** 5+ years of regulatory data validation

**About Impact Environmental**

Since 1989, Impact Environmental has carried projects from site assessment through regulatory closure under NYSDEC, NJDEP, and USEPA programs. Our decisions in the field and in our reports are only as defensible as the data underneath them.

**The Role**

We are bringing data validation in-house. You will validate laboratory data and prepare Data Usability Summary Reports (DUSRs) and validation reports for our NYSDEC, NJDEP LSRP, and USEPA projects. You set your own hours around agreed turnaround times. To keep validation independent, you will not serve on the field or reporting team for projects you validate.

**What You Will Do**

· Validate soil, groundwater, soil vapor, air, and waste characterization data and prepare DUSRs under NYSDEC DER-10 Appendix 2B, NJDEP data usability guidance (N.J.A.C. 7:26E), USEPA National Functional Guidelines, and project QAPPs.

· Perform Stage 2A through Stage 4 validation as the program and QAPP require. Stage 2B is most common on our projects.

· Cover SW-846 methods (8260D, 8270E incl. 1,4-dioxane SIM, 8081B, 8082A, 6010D/6020B, 7471B, 9012B, 7196A), PFAS by EPA 1633, and TO-15 vapor and air data, including canister QC.

· Apply qualifiers with documented rationale and translate results into clear usability conclusions for project managers.

· Add validation qualifiers to NYSDEC EQuIS EDDs, run them through the EQuIS Data Processor, and prepare NJDEP EDDs where required.

· Work with laboratories to resolve discrepancies and obtain corrected deliverables.

**What You Bring**

· Bachelor’s degree in chemistry or a related science.

· 5+ years of environmental data validation, including DUSRs or validation reports accepted by a state or federal agency. Redacted work samples may be requested.

· Hands-on experience with both limited (Stage 2A/2B) and full (Stage 3/4) validation.

· Experience validating PFAS data by EPA Method 1633.

· Independence from the laboratories whose data you review, as DER-10 requires.

· Clear writing and the ability to explain data quality to non-chemists.

· Ability to work independently, protect client data, and disclose any outside validation or consulting work.

**Preferred**

· DUSRs accepted by NYSDEC on Brownfield Cleanup Program sites.

· UFP-QAPP projects, EQuIS EDD submittals, or automated data review tools.

· Laboratory bench experience (GC/MS, GC/ECD, ICP, LC-MS/MS).

**Compensation and Benefits**

$40.00 – $60.00 per hour, based on validation experience and regulatory program and method coverage (including PFAS). This part-time position is not eligible for health and welfare benefits. Paid sick leave will be provided in accordance with applicable state and local law. Eligibility for the 401(k) retirement plan will be determined in accordance with the terms of the plan.

**How to Apply**

Apply through this posting with a current resume. Note the programs (NYSDEC, NJDEP, USEPA), methods, and validation stages you have performed. Cover letters are optional.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Impact Environmental is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodations are available on request.

**Work Location:** Remote (U.S.-based; excludes CA, CO, IL, ND, OH, WA, WY)

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
